data.title: 巴泽特·弗拉加·马克雷米兹 · 教会前的台阶
data.description: 她走下教会台阶，把外套领口整理好。门后的灯还亮着，街上已经没有声音。
data.action: descending the steps while adjusting her coat collar
data.promptProse: Descending the worn limestone steps of an ancient stone cathedral under the warm glow of an archway lantern, Bazett straightens the collar of her suit jacket with disciplined precision. Rain-slicked cobblestones in the square reflect the stained-glass window lights, while ancient gargoyles and heavy oak portals frame her commanding exit into the night.
data.animaCaption: Soft light from the church reveals her face and the stone steps.
